svg.title: Planit Stage 2 — persistent snapshots and repository boundary

g.text: Planit Stage 2 — persistent snapshots and repository boundary
Exclusive OS lock; digest guards external edits.
Flushed same-directory temp file; atomic replacement
Legacy absent blueprint refs default to null on load.
Invalid data blocks startup, not an empty-store reset.
save only when captured state changes.
Persistence/capture failure after operation restores before.
Operation exceptions are not a universal rollback guarantee.
